name: duplicate-to-calendar
description: Chrome extension to quickly duplicate Google Calendar events to another calendar

scripts.build: npm run clean && tsc && esbuild dist/background/index.js --outfile=dist/background.js --format=iife --bundle --platform=browser --target=chrome88 && esbuild dist/content/index.js --outfile=dist/content.js --format=iife --bundle --platform=browser --target=chrome88 && esbuild dist/options/index.js --outfile=dist/options.js --format=iife --bundle --platform=browser --target=chrome88
scripts.build:prod: NODE_ENV=production npm run clean && tsc && esbuild dist/background/index.js --outfile=dist/background.js --format=iife --bundle --platform=browser --target=chrome88 --minify --define:process.env.NODE_ENV='"production"' && esbuild dist/content/index.js --outfile=dist/content.js --format=iife --bundle --platform=browser --target=chrome88 --minify --define:process.env.NODE_ENV='"production"' && esbuild dist/options/index.js --outfile=dist/options.js --format=iife --bundle --platform=browser --target=chrome88 --minify --define:process.env.NODE_ENV='"production"'
scripts.dev: npm run clean && npm run build:watch

author: Google Calendar Event Duplicator Extension
